affectedReadingUnitChecks.finalParagraph:
Applications and limits
Superconductors have practical uses.
One example is a coil in a powerful electromagnet.
affectedReadingUnitChecks.assessment: The heading is excluded. The practical-use statement and its coil example are two complete sentences. The following electromagnet definition and resistance-heating/setup/cooling limitations are unchanged.

affectedReadingUnitChecks.finalParagraph:
A possibility for transmitting energy
The book imagines superconductors that work near room temperature.
They would also need to suit practical electrical transmission.
affectedReadingUnitChecks.assessment: The heading is excluded. Both short sentences remain together in the actual final paragraph, within the stated existing 180-character packing limit. The second sentence's They refers to the imagined superconductors; would also need preserves practical suitability as a hypothetical requirement. This is not a claim of an achieved room-temperature material. The following ideal-DC and operating-limit qualifications are unchanged.

affectedReadingUnitChecks.assessment: The existing whole-system-loss caution now precedes the research-aim statement in the same final paragraph. Both sentences are unchanged in wording; no scientific claim was added.
